name: mind-over-matter
description: Mind Over Matter — Next.js frontend + Express/MongoDB backend

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
